lines.zh: 我每走一步，地就低一点。
lines.en: Every step of mine sinks the ground a little.

lines.zh: 我的脚印陷进土里半尺。
lines.en: My footprints sink half a foot into the soil.

lines.zh: 护甲挡住了我大半视线
lines.en: My armour blocks most of my view.
I leave shallow dents where I walk.
I move slowly, and cannot be stopped.
Layer upon layer of plate.
I turn my cumbersome body.
The clatter of metal arrives before I do.
I am looking for something to ram.
My shadow is wider than you are tall.

lines.zh: 我站着,像一堵会动的墙
lines.en: I stand like a walking wall.
No light comes through my seams.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在甲片下面响
lines.en: My breathing sounds beneath the plates.
I turn my head slowly half round.
This armour is quite heavy.
I lift a hand and let it drop.
I listen to my own echo.
There are dents on my surface.
I have no need to hide.
Standing still is frightening enough.
I shift my weight to the other foot.
A buckle on my pauldron has come loose.
I leave the dust on my pauldron.
I wait for you to move first.
The wind passes through my seams.
My slowness is exactly right.

lines.zh: 二十点护甲的我，看你很小。
lines.en: With twenty armor, I find you small.
I lower my head; the plates clatter.
You stepped off to the side.
This is where I stand.
Fifty health, and I don't back off.
I raise one arm.
Don't surround me; my armor turns.
But I do not mind being looked at.
You had better stand farther off.
My plate is thicker than your weapon.
I am smiling under the visor.
You simply cannot see it.
A new dent in my plate.
I step back; the ground sounds.
That will not pry me open.
My armour still holds.
Turning my body slowly. It's heavy.
Nothing got inside.
My plates part, then close again.
Twenty points of armor cover me.
I can fight for a long while yet.
Do not count on a second.
My plate feeds only on blows.
What you hold is too light.
That will not stop one punch from me.
I reach out; my plates part.
Put it in.
I have already caught it.

lines.zh: 它在我的甲缝里卡住了
lines.en: It is stuck in a seam.

lines.zh: 你举的东西，还没我的甲重。
lines.en: What you hold weighs less than my armor.
Have you anything else?
If not, step aside.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的甲上,弹开了
lines.en: You hit my plate and bounced.

lines.zh: 你的拳头，连甲缝都没碰到。
lines.en: Your fist didn't even reach my seams.
Your wrist must hurt now.
My plate is thick, as you can feel.
You were knocked back two steps.

lines.zh: 五十点生命，二十点护甲顶着。
lines.en: Fifty health behind twenty armor.
A dull note between my plates.
That force cannot pry me open.
Go around me.
Do not walk against me.

lines.zh: 这身甲让很多事不方便
lines.en: This armour makes many things awkward.
I can raise the visor.
What is inside is not pleasant.
Do you still want to look?
I have lowered my arm.
You stand in the shadow of my plate.
This plate has shielded many.
Now it shields you as well.
Do not stray from this armour.
This armor keeps me sealed inside.
I bend; every plate sounds.
This won't fit between my plates.
This is too small in my grip.
It is caught in my plate.
I drop it into a seam.
My fingers close and it goes quiet.
But it is mine now.
I open my hand: only a thin flake is left.
It is rather interesting.
Do you want it back?
I heard your steps.
I turn, plates facing you.

lines.zh: 这身甲不是拿来站着看的
lines.en: This armour is not for standing around in.
I have you fully fixed.
My fist is clenched.
You are standing in the open.
I accept this fight.

lines.zh: 我的甲很重,但我的拳头更重
lines.en: Heavy armour, heavier fist.
You still have time to leave.
I lift a foot; the ground sounds first.
Do not think of fleeing.
One of my steps covers three of yours.
Then I act now.

lines.zh: 面甲后面的我看得很清楚
lines.en: I see you clearly behind the visor.
Very clearly.
Here and now.
I have come already.

lines.zh: 你的气息，撞在我的甲上。
lines.en: Your presence strikes my plate.
Every plate faces you now.
Stand there and do not move.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的方向碾过去
lines.en: I grind in your direction.

lines.zh: 你跑不过我这一身重量
lines.en: You cannot outrun this weight.
My plates have locked tight.

lines.zh: 我每走一步,地就沉一截
lines.en: Each step sinks the ground a little.
I wait for you to run into me.
You have gone to my flank.
That is armour as well.
Your weapon is hunting for a seam.
The seams are pitifully narrow.
I let you look.
You have started panting.
And I am not tired at all.
The distance keeps shrinking.
I need no extra speed at all.
You just stand there.
I can wait forever.
But you cannot.
I raise my fist.
This one carries weight.
It will not feel heavy when it lands.
The fist comes down from above.

lines.zh: 甲片的响声跟着一起到
lines.en: The clatter of plates arrives with it.
You are driven to your knees.
My plate took no dent.
That punch landed solid.
I raise my hand for another.
You blocked it, and fell far back.
Something is on my knuckles.
I shake my fist.
I stand my ground.
You are still standing.
Then once again.
I will not pull this one.
You should have dodged.
The plates sound first.
I push myself up from the ground.
Plate after plate locks into place.
I stand, taller than you by a head.
The visor comes down.
The visor drops; the seams close.
A little breath escapes my seams.

lines.zh: 地面被我的重量压得呻吟。
lines.en: The ground groans under my weight.

lines.zh: 我站直，顶到这片天的边。
lines.en: I straighten and reach the edge of the sky.

lines.zh: 金属的声音在四周回荡
lines.en: The sound of metal echoes around.
I need no weapon.
This armour is my weapon.
I lift my first foot.
I have arrived here.
You may start running.
But not far.
Every piece on me is plate.
Go on and look for yourself.

lines.zh: 地在我脚下先塌了一寸。
lines.en: The ground sinks an inch under my first step.

lines.zh: 护甲扣紧的声音，一路响。
lines.en: Buckles closing, all down the line.
My plate grows too hot to touch.

lines.zh: 这般重量砸下去便起不来
lines.en: At this weight, I cannot rise again.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲里，我动作慢了。
lines.en: Water in my plate; my movements slow.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的甲掀开一角
lines.en: The blast lifts a corner of my plate.

lines.zh: 一根东西卡在我的甲片之间
lines.en: Something wedges between my plates.

lines.zh: 那股力量从甲缝钻进去
lines.en: That force slips in through a seam.
This armour will not hold me long.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的甲走了一圈
lines.en: Lightning runs around my plate.
No matter the plate, there is no ground.
